mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; vancomycin may indirectly affect renal clearance and both drugs have anticholinergic/CNS effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, cognitive changes) and adjust tolterodine dose if renal function is impaired during vancomycin therapy.
